description: R-SQL-1 SQL-AGG-TYPE: Per aggregate, what result Field.Type/Size/Precision/Scale and value VARTYPE does ACE give over each stored type (Byte, Integer, Long, Single, Double, Currency, Date, Text for Min/Max, Decimal): Sum, Avg, Min, Max each in its own statement over rows without the maxima row; then Sum over all rows, one column per statement, to find each overflow and its phase. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.

args.text: SELECT Sum(b) AS Sum_b, Sum(i) AS Sum_i, Sum(l) AS Sum_l, Sum(s) AS Sum_s, Sum(d) AS Sum_d, Sum(c) AS Sum_c, Sum(dt) AS Sum_dt FROM N WHERE id <> 5
SELECT Sum(x) AS Sum_x FROM ND WHERE id <> 5
SELECT Avg(b) AS Avg_b, Avg(i) AS Avg_i, Avg(l) AS Avg_l, Avg(s) AS Avg_s, Avg(d) AS Avg_d, Avg(c) AS Avg_c, Avg(dt) AS Avg_dt FROM N WHERE id <> 5
SELECT Avg(x) AS Avg_x FROM ND WHERE id <> 5
SELECT Min(b) AS Min_b, Min(i) AS Min_i, Min(l) AS Min_l, Min(s) AS Min_s, Min(d) AS Min_d, Min(c) AS Min_c, Min(dt) AS Min_dt, Min(t) AS Min_t FROM N
SELECT Max(b) AS Max_b, Max(i) AS Max_i, Max(l) AS Max_l, Max(s) AS Max_s, Max(d) AS Max_d, Max(c) AS Max_c, Max(dt) AS Max_dt, Max(t) AS Max_t FROM N
SELECT Min(x) AS Min_x, Max(x) AS Max_x FROM ND
SELECT Sum(b) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(i) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(l) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(s) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(d) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(c) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(dt) AS v FROM N
SELECT Sum(x) AS v FROM ND
